Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Shafali Verma and Shweta Sehrawat to open for India. Dewmi Vihanga to bowl first.
...THE CHASE...

It was a good toss to win for India. They came with a plan and bowled accordingly. They used spinners mostly but Titas Sadhu, the only seamer started the downfall. She took the solitary wicket but then the other spinners kept it tight and everyone looked eager to take a wicket. However, it was the spin web of Parshavi Chopra which did all the damage. Sri Lanka were finding it hard to read her wristwork. She claimed four wickets. Now then, India have an inferior score to chase. Should be easy for them unless Sri Lanka find some magic.

A sorry looking batting card for Sri Lanka! They have managed to crawl past 50. Yes, crawled because runs were hard to buy. It does not look good for them. Only two players had a double digit score, that tells you the story. Vishmi Gunaratne tried her best to accelerate but fell soon. Umaya Rathnayake tried to stay till the end but was finding it difficult to score and eventually gave away her wicket. The bowlers had a tough job in their hand.

OUT! RUN OUT! Full and on middle, flicked straight to mid-wicket. Vidushika Perera tries to snatch a run which was never available. Parshavi Chopra throws to Verma who removes the bails. Easy decision for the umpire. Sri Lanka Women Under-19 end with just 59.
Tossed up on middle. Rashmi Nethranjalee whacks it to deep square leg for one.
On off, kept out.
Very full and on middle, bunted to mid-wicket for a sharp single.
Flatter and outside off. Rashmi Nethranjalee strokes it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full and on off, Vidushika Perera whips it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Rashmi Nethranjalee looks to heave but gets a top edge to short third man where it falls safely. Two.
Full and outside off, worked to long on for one.
OUT! CAUGHT! Tossed up, outside off. Umaya Rathnayake tries to go big as she dances down the track and heaves but fails to middle and Titas Sadhu takes it at deep mid-wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Titas Sadhu b Archana Devi

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off. Rashmi Nethranjalee splices her drives to backward point for one.
Goes very full, outside off. Rashmi Nethranjalee again fails to connect.
Slants a full ball, outside off. Rashmi Nethranjalee looks to heave but misses.
India are appealing but the umpire shakes head! Short and outside off. Rathnayake looks to cut but seems to miss.
Outside off, flatter. Rathnayake looks to cut but toe ends her shot on the off side.
Full and outside off, driven to the right of mid off for one.
Full and outside off, Rathnayake comes down and eases it to mid off for a quick single.
Shorter and outside off. Rathnayake shuffles across but fails to cut.
Outside off, kept out.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
On middle, clipped to deep square leg for one.
Very full and on off. Umaya Rathnayake skips down and pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter and outside off, turns in. Umaya Rathnayake fails to push.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Important runs! Very full and outside off. Umaya Rathnayake drives and it goes through covers for four.
This one spins in and hits Umaya Rathnayake on the pads as she looks to flick.
Tossed up on off, defended out. What a spell from Parshavi Chopra.

OUT! TAKEN! Easy catch there! Parshavi Chopra gets her fourth! Too full and on leg. Dissanayake leans to flick but mistimes and it goes straight in the hands of Shweta Sehrawat at mid-wicket who takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Shweta Sehrawat b Parshavi Chopra

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! Way down the leg side. Dissanayake misses her sweep.
Flatter and outside off, tapped to cover.
A single as this is heaved to mid-wicket.
Very full and on off, Umaya Rathnayake uses her feet and pushes it to cover.
Flatter and outside off, knocked to point.
On off, defended out.
Fuller delivery, outside off. Dissanayake tries to play across the line but misses. The keeper is quick to remove the bails. Dissanayake seems just in.
On off, kept out.
Full and on off. Dissanayake looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes past the diving slip fielder to third man for two.
Was that a chance? On off, Umaya Rathnayake smashes it over leaping Devi. A single is taken. Was just over the bowler.
Fuller and outside off, played back to Devi.
Shorter and on leg, Dulanga Dissanayake looks to pull but misses. It was pitching outside the line. Two wickets and no runs from the over.

OUT! LBW! Sri Lanka are not able to read Chopra! Flights it full and on middle. Sewwandi tries to reverse sweep but misses and gets hit plumb in front of the stumps. An appeal and up goes the finger. Parshavi Chopra is just too good right now. Three wickets for her.
That was close! A leggie, full and around off. Vihara Sewwandi looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
On the pads, kept out.

OUT! TAKEN! Pressure gets big on Nanayakkara! A googly, full and outside off. Nanayakkara goes for the drive but slices it to point where Archana Devi first fails to judge the flight and then had to dive forward to take the catch. Sri Lanka Women Under-19 are five down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Archana Devi b Parshavi Chopra

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on  off, blocked.
A flighted full toss on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full and on off, pushed to cover.
Devi angles it across, outside off. Nanayakkara fails to punch it away.
Flat and outside off, slapped to cover.
Just two! This one spins away from outside off. Nanayakkara looks to push but gets an outside edge past backward point for two.
Tossed up, outside off, spins away. Nanayakkara looks to push but misses.
Just a single of the over! India won't mind! On the pads, Nanayakkara glances it to fine leg for one.
Excellent bowling so far! This is outside off, it is pulled to mid-wicket.
Shorter and outside off. Nanayakkara looks to punch but misses again.
Floats it on leg, Nanayakkara works it back to the bowler.
Very full and on leg. Nanayakkara keeps it out.
Drops it short and outside off, cut to point.
Tosses it up on off. Nanayakkara pushes it to mid off and takes a quick single.
Fuller and on off, pushed to cover.
Tossed up, outside off. Umaya Rathnayake skips down and slogs it to long on for one.
Just two! Shorter and outside off. Umaya Rathnayake plays it late past backward point for brace.
Fuller and on off, kept out.
There is spin! Outside off and spins away. Umaya Rathnayake looks to defend but misses.

OUT! BOWLED! This is the wicket India wanted! That is a peach of a delivery! A leggie, around off but this does not turn much. Vishmi Gunaratne comes way down the track and expects to spin but it goes past her leg and hits the stumps.
On off, kept out.
Flat and outside off. Umaya Rathnayake pulls it to deep mid-wicket. A misfield but only a single is taken.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
This one stays low, outside off. Gunaratne looks to cut but misses.
Targets the middle stump. It is blocked.
This is short and outside off, cut to cover.
Around off, pushed to long off for one.
Off the mark! Fuller and on off. Umaya Rathnayake skips down and pushes it to long off.
Umaya Rathnayake yet to get off the mark! Short and around off. She fails to defend this.
Very full and on middle. Umaya Rathnayake looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Slower and outside off. Umaya Rathnayake has a poke at it but misses.
Very full and on off, nudged to mid-wicket.
Very full and on off, played back to the bowler.
Tossed up, outside off and spins away. Gunaratne looks to defend but fails.
Outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne gets a thickish outside edge to third man for two.
Shorter and outside off, Gunaratne slaps it to cover where the ball goes through the girl's hand. Two taken.
Slants it on leg. Gunaratne lunges forward and defense.
This is superb from India! Pressure all over Sri Lanka! Flat and outside off, knocked to point.
One more dot! Outside off, slapped straight to point.
Another dot! This lands on off and spins away. Umaya Rathnayake looks to defend but misses.
Fuller and on off, pushed to cover.
Floated, outside off. Umaya Rathnayake tries to swing across but misses. The keeper puts on a stumping appeal but Umaya Rathnayake had her back foot in.
Slower in the air, outside off, Gunaratne punches it to point. A misfield and a single is taken.

It is put down! Mannat with a chance! This is full and on off. Umaya Rathnayake strokes it back to Mannat Kashyap who dives to her left and gets to the bowl but as she falls down, she fumbles to hold on.
This is excellent bowling! Outside off. Umaya Rathnayake drops it to cover.
Outside off. Umaya Rathnayake punches off the back foot to cover.
This is full and slanting on off. Umaya Rathnayake prods to defend but splices it to point.
Flatter and outside off, punched to cover.

OUT! LBW! India all over Sri Lanka! Mannat Kashyap flights it very full and around off. Dewmi Vihanga steps across to whip to the leg side but misses it completely. An appeal and up goes the finger. That was an easy decision for the umpire. Plumb in front.
FOUR! 6 runs off the over. A full toss on off. Gunaratne punches on the up and over mid off and the ball races into the fence.
On top of off. Gunaratne defends it to cover.
Pushes it full and on off. Gunaratne keeps it out.
Full ball on middle. Gunaratne eases it to mid on.
Length ball, outside off. Dewmi Vihanga works it to cover for one.
On middle, pushed to mid on for a quick single.

This is way outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne drops it to cover. Gunaratne wants a single and Dewmi Vihanga was a bit late to react. Shafali Verma throws it to the keeper but the umpire feels Dewmi Vihanga is safe. One. Touch and go there.
On off, kept out.
Mannat Kashyap tosses it up, outside off. Dewmi Vihanga slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket where it falls safely. One.
Flighted on off. Dewmi Vihanga defends it out.
A single as this is hit to mid off.
FOUR! Good shot! This is way outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne frees her arms and guides it through backward point for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off, punched to cover.
Outside off, guided to point.
Fuller ball, slanting on middle. Blocked.
On a length and on off, Dewmi Vihanga taps it to cover.
Full and on middle, this is driven to the left of mid on. Good diving stop.
A huge appeal for LBW But it might go down the leg side. This is full and on middle, tails in very late. Gunaratne is stuck on the back foot looking to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Flights it again. Dewmi Vihanga defends.
Flighted on off, Dewmi Vihanga defends on the front foot.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! What a catch by Tiwari! That was really sharp! India get the other opener! Tossed up, outside off, turns in. Sumudu Nisansala is drawn forward as she looks to defend but gets an outside edge and Soumya Tiwari at first slip takes a low catch to her left.
Commentary.Howout: c Soumya Tiwari b Mannat Kashyap

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off. Sumudu Nisansala slaps it to point who lets it through her legs for a couple.
Three more! Good shot and good running as well! Short and outside off, this is cut through cover-point for easy three.
Tossed up, outside off. Gunaratne leans and defends.
Mannat Kashyap to bowl from the other end.
A length ball, way outside off. Sumudu Nisansala flashes and misses.
Beauty! Length ball, outside off. Sumudu Nisansala looks to defend across but misses.
Full and outside off, dabbed to point.
Three runs and Sri Lanka are off the mark! Length and on middle, this is flicked past mid-wicket. The fielder misfields and the batters take three in the mean time.
On a length and on off, nips in. Vishmi Gunaratne stays back and blocks it out.

OUT! TAKEN! What a start for India! They are wasting no time! Titas Sadhu serves a full ball, outside off, it is there to drive and Nethmi Senarathne goes but uppishly and Archana Devi at covers take a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Archana Devi b Titas Sadhu

Commentary.Commentary: It is time for action. The Indian players are out in the middle. Nethmi Senarathne and Sumudu Nisansala are the openers for Sri Lanka. Titas Sadhu to start with the ball. A slip in place for her. Let's play...
We are all set but before the action we will have the national anthems. It will be Lanka's first followed by India's.

Sri Lanka Women Under-19 (Playing XI) - Nethmi Senarathne, Sumudu Nisansala (WK), Vishmi Gunaratne (C), Dewmi Vihanga, Manudi Nanayakkara, Umaya Rathnayake, Dulanga Dissanayake, Vihara Sewwandi, Rashmi Nethranjalee, Vidushika Perera, Rishmi Sanjana.

India Women Under-19 (Playing XI) - Shweta Sehrawat, Shafali Verma (C), Soumya Tiwari, Gongadi Trisha, Richa Ghosh (WK), Hrishita Basu, Titas Sadhu, Mannat Kashyap, Archana Devi, Parshavi Chopra, Sonam Yadav.
TOSS - India Women Under-19 have won the toss and will bowl first.

Hello and welcome to the match between India Women Under-19 and Sri Lanka Women Under-19 in the Super 6 stage. The contest has been super interesting till now. India were in a really good form but were handed their first defeat of the tournament by the hands of Australia. Still, there is nothing much to worry as they are in a good position and are facing a team who are minnows on the side. Sri Lanka Women Under-19 need to be bang on in this game as they face one of the contenders to win the tournament. Can they upset their Asian neighbors or India Women Under-19 will go onto win it comfortably? Will find out soon. Toss coming up soon.

The Super 6 stage of the inaugural ICC Women’s U-19 T20 World Cup is getting interesting and we now have India Women Under-19 taking on Sri Lanka Women Under-19. India Women Under-19 dominated the group stage by winning all three of their games but are now in a tricky position after losing the first Super 6 game to Australia. However, they have carried the four points from the group stage and if they win thus game against Sri Lanka Women Under-19 they are still in with a great chance due to their superior net run rate. Sri Lanka Women Under-19, on the other hand, finished third in Group A with a win over the USA and have their task cut out here. They lost against Bangladesh Women Under-19 and Australia Women Under-19 and they need to take their game a step higher if they want to get over India here. For Sri Lanka, Vishmi Gunaratne and Dewmi Vihanga were brilliant against a strong bowling unit of Bangladesh Women but their batting unit crumbled quite drastically against Australia and that is something they can’t afford again. Their skipper Vishmi Gunaratne is crucial for them while in the bowling department too they need to be upto the task against a powerful Indian batting line-up. India Women Under-19, on the other hand, had a bad day in the office against Australia Women U-19 and they cannot afford any further hiccups if they want to advance into the semis. The star batting line-up failed to deliver for the first time against the Aussies in this tournament and India would hope that their belligerent top 3 fire all guns blazing in this game. Shweta Sehrawat has been very consistent and against the Aussies too she was the only one who showed some resistance. However, Shafali Verma and Richa Ghosh need to find their mojo in this very crucial game for their side and let’s see how they go about their business in this game. In the bowling department, it has been a collective effort from the girls from India with Mannat Kashyap leading the bowling charts and India would be looking to comeback stronger in this game. Can Sri Lanka Women Under-19 pull the rabbit out of the hat and stage an upset by beating India Women Under-19 here? Or will Shafali Verma and her girls outclass their southern neighbours? Let’s find out.
